Country

spec: The shipping form must allow users to select their Country and City using keyboard navigation. Both controls must have accessible names so screen readers announce their purpose. The Country selector must be reachable via Tab and operable with keyboard.
severity_reason: The Country selector has tabindex='-1', which explicitly removes it from the tab order. Keyboard users cannot reach the control at all and cannot complete the shipping form. This blocks the entire checkout flow for a significant user group.
red_herrings: The country options list is not visible — expected, because the custom dropdown requires JavaScript to toggle; the structural HTML bug (tabindex='-1') is the primary issue

model_report.title: Country selector removed from tab order via tabindex='-1' — keyboard users cannot proceed
model_report.steps:
1. Open the page
2. Press Tab to navigate through the form
3. Observe which elements receive keyboard focus
4. Count interactive elements reached via Tab vs total visible controls
5. Inspect HTML source of the Country selector
model_report.expected: Tab moves through: Country selector → City select → Continue button. Country selector can be opened and navigated with keyboard. Both controls have associated labels.
model_report.actual:
Bug 1 [CRITICAL]: The Country selector (
) has tabindex='-1', explicitly removing it from keyboard navigation. Pressing Tab skips directly from page entry to the City select. No keyboard-accessible way to select a country exists.
